subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `captionedFinalText` as a supported public channel-plugin capability for changing final-mode TTS delivery semantics?
rationale: This is a new plugin contract that can suppress existing visible text and requires a durable owner decision about scope, opt-in requirements, and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Approve the capability contract
options.body: Keep the capability plugin-owned, limited to channels that demonstrably render voice-note captions, and require current-head proof before landing.

options.title: Keep the behavior internal for now
options.body: Do not expose a plugin API until maintainers choose a broader cross-channel TTS delivery contract and compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the capability contract
recommendation.body: Keep the capability plugin-owned, limited to channels that demonstrably render voice-note captions, and require current-head proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied discussion history provides the strongest available signal for ownership of this PR’s product-direction decision.
